name: Narrus Linhen
original_name: ナルルース＝ルィンヘン
source:
A dark elf charged with protecting the queen.
As a dark elf she was originally at conflict with the high elves, however after Ephildis became queen their relationships improved. As proof of friendship between high and dark elves, Narrus was appointed as a knight in the queen's guard.
Princess Almia adores her as an older sister and while she is aware of her own position, she also values Almia like a younger sister.
Unlike elves or high elves as a dark elf she has some resistance to hypnosis, so while her body can be control he consciousness remains.
